relations.note: Logos and Zoe emit Anthropos and Ecclesia in the Ptolemaean genealogy.
Logos and Zoe emit Anthropos and Ecclesia in the Ptolemaean genealogy.
Ecclesia is Anthropos' female syzygos and co-generator of twelve aeons.
Anthropos and Ecclesia jointly emit the twelve aeons completing the Thirty.
Colorbasus reverses the standard sequence, making Anthropos and Ecclesia generate Logos and Zoe.
Colorbasus reverses the standard sequence, making Anthropos and Ecclesia generate Logos and Zoe.
Some Valentinians derive Jesus from Anthropos and Ecclesia; rival schools give other origins.
Gabriel corresponds to Logos while the Power of the Highest corresponds to Anthropos.
The Spirit corresponds to Zoe while the Power of the Highest corresponds to Anthropos.
The lower creator forms earthly humanity according to the pre-existent Human's archetypal image.
The perfect heavenly Human appears or is named with the Invisible Spirit's approval.
Barbelo's upper divine order enables revelation of the heavenly Human's form to the rulers.
The heavenly Adamas is established beside Autogenes in Harmozel's first aeon.
The heavenly Adamas is assigned to the first aeon within Harmozel's luminary realm.
Seth succeeds Adamas in the next luminary realm and progenates the incorruptible race.
Yaldabaoth sees the upper Human's image and helps manufacture lower Adam as its copy.
The rulers imitate the revealed Human's watery image and distribute powers into Adam.

relations.myth: The Hermetic Man's union with Nature
relations.note: The Man and Nature love one another and unite, producing terrestrial humanity's double nature.
Nous generates the Hermetic Man in his own image and loves him as his child.

relations.myth: The Hermetic Man traverses the spheres
relations.note: The Man traverses their spheres and shares in their nature, powers, and rule.

relations.myth: The Hermetic Man encounters the cosmos
relations.note: Demiurgic rational activity orders the cosmos through which the Hermetic Man passes.

relations.myth: Naassene interpretation of the Attis hymn
relations.note: Naassene exegesis interprets the Phrygian Attis through its doctrine of the primal Man.

relations.myth: Naassene testimonies to the primal Man
relations.note: Naassene exegesis invokes Hermes as a pagan witness to its doctrine of Man.
Naassene exegesis interprets Osirian mysteries as parallels or expressions of primal-Man doctrine.
The Gnosis of Life participates in the light-world mission that instructs Adam.
Hibil Ziwa overcomes dark powers and aids primordial humanity and embodied souls.

relations.myth: Entrapment of Adam in the material cosmos
relations.note: Ruha and her planetary children attempt to tempt, seduce, and entrap Adam.
Adam Kasia is identified or closely coordinated with the primordial heavenly priest Šišlam.

relations.myth: Emanation and commissioning of First Man
relations.note: The Father ultimately calls forth First Man as his champion against Darkness.

relations.myth: Emanation and commissioning of First Man
relations.note: The Mother of Life produces or calls forth First Man for battle.

other_aliases: Light, Air, Fire, Water, and Ether
relations.note: First Man wears his Five Sons as armor and offers them in battle.
First Man confronts Darkness and is overwhelmed after its powers consume his luminous armor.
Living Spirit calls, First Man answers, and Living Spirit draws him from the abyss.
